note: Kentucky State Parks campground on a wooded ridge above the salt springs where Ice Age fossils were first studied, near Union; paved back-in sites strung along one road with small loops. Bison herd, re-created Pleistocene marsh, museum and trails in the park. The campground pool is closed indefinitely and the park lake is closed for a dam leak. --Claude
